items.coder_A: ["autologous tumor lysate-pulsed dendritic cell vaccine (atl-dc)", "poly iclc"]
items.reason: Naming difference only; manual W2 gives excluded types a short generic name such as "dendritic cell vaccine". Regimen combination stands.

note: Both coders coded poly ICLC soc_backbone; under D30-R4 it is a vaccine adjuvant and so part of the excluded therapy (excluded_intervention_type). Not a candidate either way. D31 changes nothing: combination_partners already lists every other agent given with pembrolizumab (C2), and no radiotherapy is given.
